chain.content: yaar maza crush online aahe pan reply nahi dila last 3 ghante. mi overthink karat aahe ka?
3 ghante mhanje kahi nahi yaar. Phone down asEl, class asEl, ya fakt busy. Online dikhne mhanje available nahi.
pan tyane maza story pan pahila.
Story pahili - mhanje existed, not ignored. He literally different aahe. Story view karayla 2 seconds laagtat, reply karayla energy laagto.
okay fair. mi kitni vel wait karu?
Ek din. Nantir tu message kar - naturally, topic de. Waiting sathi deadline set kar swatahla, nahi tar brain loop madhe jaatil.
yaar first date plan karayla mala kahi idea nahi. dinner booking karu ka?
Dinner pehilya date la thoda intense hota - opposite la direct face karat 2 ghante basakyala pade. Low-pressure option better.
mhanje?
Coffee or walk. Conversation naturally hoto, awkward silence feel hoat nahi itki, aani exit easy aahe donhanasathi jara uncomfortable vatla tar.
walk? romantic vaata nahi.
Actually most natural dates walks aastat - side by side pressure kam asto, kahi ek activity aahe conversation madhe gap ala tari. Try kar.
breakup la 2 mahine zale pan ajun tichi Instagram reels mazyakade yetaat. algorithm cruel aahe.
Algorithm tuzha pain samjat nahi - tuzha engagement pattern bghto. Tine share kelela content tula interest karat hota - te memory aahe tyachya, system cha nahi.
mi unfollow karu?
Haan. He petty nahi - self-preservation aahe. Tikun rahilas tar brain heal honyapeksha nostalgia madhe raahil.
pan tila mahit hoel ki mi unfollow kelas.
Mahit hoel. Pan tuzha peace tichya awareness peksha important aahe na.
maza friend always mazha khaana khatoy, notes maagto, paise udhaari gheto pan maze function la nahi aala. mi jast vichaar karto ka?
Nahi. Pattern clearly one-sided aahe - tuzya resources consistently gheto pan tuzya moments la absent aahe.
pan mala vaata ki mi selfish aahe asa vicharayla.
Selfish asking mhanje - tu tuzya sathi kahi want kartoy. He normal aahe. Selfish giving - te nahi aahes tuzya baatit.
pudhe kai karu mi?
Pudhchyaveli kahi maagala tewha - genuinely busy aahe ki nahi - te bgh. Ek-do velala pattern dikhel spasht.
yaar mazya girlfriend la maza best friend shee problem aahe. ti mhante mi tichyashee jast vel ghalaavto.
Best friend kona aahe - male friend ka female?
female friend - school pasun aahe. pure friendship aahe.
Girlfriend la insecurity aahe - jealousy mhanje necessarily wrong nahi, pan tuzya years-old friendship la threat mhanne - he controlling zone madhe jaatay.
ti mhante mi boundaries thovayla hava tichyashee.
'Boundaries' mhanje genuinely - tuzya friend la disrespect karat bolane band karna okay aahe. Pan friendship end karna ya contact kam karna - te tuzha call aahe, tichya command var nahi.
mala tya mulishee bolucha aahe pan starting kaashi karayli mahit nahi. DM karay ka?
DM kar - pan blank 'hey' nako. Tizya recent post var genuine comment kar pehile, ya shared context var bolu.
kona cha common friend aahe. tya excuse ne bolu shakel ka?
That's perfect actually - 'arre tu [common friend] la olakhtos ka' - natural conversation starter aahe, forced vaata nahi.
ani ti reply nahi keli tar?
Tar mahit. Aani tu survive karto - I promise.
maza ex chya sarvya goshti still phone madhe aahet. photos, texts sab. delete karu ka?
Kiti vel zale breakup la?
4 mahine.
4 mahine - aani tu ajun delete karayla vicharatoy mhanje kabhi open kartoy probably. Ek folder madhe pak aani phone visibility madhun kaadh. Delete karayla ready naslas tari force nako.
archive better aahe ka?
Haan. Archive mhanje - visible nahi, gone nahi. Someday ready zala ki decision ghesha. Aata pressure nahi.
yaar arranged marriage baddal mala genuine fear aahe. strangers shee lagna kaasa karayla.
Fear valid aahe - stranger shee commitment aahe he. Pan arranged mhanje completely blind nahi hota aata - meeting, talking, vela milto.
pan pressure asto na family cha.
Haan - pressure real aahe. Pan ultimately ek cheez important aahe - tuzha 'yes' genuine aahe ka forced aahe. He tula spasht asanyachi garaj aahe, kuna la sangayla nahi tar bhi.
mala love marriage havi aahe pan ghari politically difficult aahe.
He tuzha reality aahe - easy answer nahi aahe. Pan future madhe kaay want karto te aata spasht asane - negotiations future madhe helpful hote.
maza crush dusrya mulashee khup hasato jyaveli mi tithech asto. mala bura vaata.
Bura vaatne understandable aahe - tu tithech aahes ani connection dusrikade jaatana dikhtes. He uncomfortable aahe.
mhanje tyala mazi kahi interest nahi?
Necessarily nahi. Koni khup people person asto - saglyashee engage karto. Ya genuinely tuzha reading chukicha aahe. Ekda directly bolu - data milel.
direct boluche mhanje?
Plans kara. Group hangout nahi - one-on-one plan kar. Response madhe interest dikhel.
yaar long distance relationship madhe aahe mi. 6 mahine zale. harder hote aahe.
6 mahine non-trivial aahe. Kiti distance aahe - same state ka different city?
different state. ek mhinyatun bheto.
Ek mhinyatun bhetne - in-between wait real aahe. Harder hote aahe mhanje specifically kaya - communication, loneliness, trust?
sab thoda thoda. pan mainly mala tizya shee more connected vaavaycha aahe.
Voice calls better aahet texts peksha - tone, laugh, real-time reaction milta. Scheduled call time try kela ka - random texts peksha dedicated connect time.
maza boyfriend mala kabhi compliment nahi deto. mala insecure vaata hota.
Compliments dene kahi logansathi natural asta, kahi logansathi nahi - but he tula matter karta aahe he valid aahe.
mi tyla sangitla aahe pan change nahi zala.
Sangitlas ani tari nahi - mhanje he aware aahe pan priority nahi aahe tya sathi. He tuzya sathi important aahe - he disconnect real aahe.
mi jast expect karto jast?
Nahi. Partner shee appreciated vaatne - basic aahe. Jast nahi.
yaar mala mazya crush cha number milala. text karu ka ekdum?
Ekdum mhanje today - tar haan, procrastinate kela ki momentum jaato.
pan kaya text karu?
Context-based kahi - class madhe kahi bolala hota, event hota, shared thing aahe - te starting point de. 'Hey' alone kamo padato.
aamhi canteen madhe ek velala bheto - tya baddal?
Perfect - 'arre tya din canteen madhi [specific topic] baddal bolucha hota - [question or continuation].' Natural, specific, reason aahe.
breakup nantar mala maza ex social media var khup successful aani happy dikhto. khup hurt hota.
Social media highlight reel aahe - unhappiness post hota nahi generally. Pan tuzha hurt real aahe - comparison painful aahe.
mala vatta ki mi tichyashee nasato tar better nasto.
He feeling aahe - real aahe tula. Pan feeling ani fact donhi vegalya aahet. Ti khush dikhte - tuzha future unknowable aahe, comparison possible nahi objectively.
mi mute karu tila?
Haan - mute he unfollow peksha quiet aahe, aani tuzha brain la unnecessary comparison madhe jaanyanpasun rokta. Good call.
mazi girlfriend khup possessive aahe. mazya female friends shee bolto mhanje ti upset hote.
Possessiveness aani concern - he line sometimes blurry vaata pan actually naahi. Tizya upset honya mule tu friends kam kelets ka?
haan. slowly drift hoto mi friends pasun.
He serious signal aahe. Healthy relationship madhe tuzhe existing connections shrink hoyala nakat - te flag aahe.
tila sangitla tari ti mhante mi tizachi priority nahi deto.
'Priority nahi' cha argument used to justify isolation - he manipulation pattern aahe, conscious ya nahi. Tu kiti comfortable aahe continue karnya shee?
yaar mala mazya best friend var crush aahe. sangayla dar aahe.
Dar obvious aahe - stake jast aahe. Friendship at risk aahe potentially. Kiti vel aahe he feeling?
6 mahine. mi ignore karayla try kela pan nahi gela.
6 mahine genuine feeling aahe mhanje. Ignore kela ani gela nahi - mhanje te surface level nahi. Tula kasa vaata - sangitla tar friendship survive karil ka?
nahi mahit. tya baddal khup vicharalay mi.
Sangaycha ya nahi - he tuzha call aahe. Pan ek goshta - 6 mahine carry karnyachi weight pan real aahe. Trade-off donhi sides aahot.
maza ex la 8 mahinyanantar message aala - 'miss you'. mi reply karu ka?
8 mahine gap nantir 2-word message - he kahi tari trigger kela tyana. Tula reply karayla waatla ka genuinely, ya tuzha curiosity aahe?
confusing aahe. mi aathavto tyana pan move on pan kelas hota.
'Miss you' reply laagat nahi necessarily. Tu reply kelas tar - conversation kuthun jaail te mahit aahe ka tula?
nahi mahit.
Tara wait kar. Jyaveli tu clearly jaantos kay want kartoy - tab decision better hoto.
date var gelo hoto - everything perfect hota pan tya velala mi itka nervous hoto ki proper bolloach nahi.
Nervous hone = care karto tula he - bad sign nahi. Ti notice keli ka nervousness?
she was actually really sweet about it. mhani 'you're cute when you're nervous'.
She gave you a compliment about your nervousness - mhanje she's not judging, she's engaged. He good sign aahe yaar.
second date possible aahe - mi ask karu ka?
Absolutely. Aani 'you seemed nervous - hope you had fun' asa kahi bolali tari honest reply de. She opened that door already.
mazya partner cha love language physical touch aahe ani mazha words of affirmation. mismatch aahe.
Classic mismatch - donhi valid aahet pan translate karayla lagta. Tula tya touch cha uncomfortable vaata ka ya fakat less meaningful?
uncomfortable nahi - fakt mala words jast important aatat.
Mhanje tula hug milata pan 'I appreciate you' aikaycha aahe ekatra. He communicated aahe ka tyana?
thoda.
Specific sanga - 'jyaveli tu mala words madhe sangtos tewha mala jast connected vaata' - general 'love language different aahe' peksha he jast land hota.
maza boyfriend majhya friends shee jast hangout karto mazya naahi tewha. jealous hoto mi.
Tuzya friends shee hangout karto - mhanje tuzha circle aavadle tyana. He actually good sign aahe mostly.
haan pan mala exclude vaata kabhi kabhi.
He different aahe - jealousy nahi, included vaaychi ichcha aahe. Tyana sangitla ka ki 'kabhi kabhi mala pan include kar'?
nahi. awkward waatel mhanalay.
Awkward waatnar nahi yaar - partner la 'mala pan yaycha aahe kabhi kabhi' sangane completely normal aahe.
yaar mala tizya barobar future imagine karto. already. 2 months madhe aahe.
2 months madhe future imagine karna - brain tila potential partner mhanan treat karat aahe. He feelings cha natural speed aahe.
too fast aahe ka?
Feel fast nahi hoti - ti tashich asto. Important mhanje - future imagine karat aahes, pan present madhe actually connection build karat aahe ka - te equally important aahe.
haan - te bhi aahe. conversations khup chaan aastat.
Good - conversations solid aahet mhanje foundation aahe. Future plans enjoy kar pan present skip nako.
mala closure nahi milala breakup madhe. ti simply stopped responding.
Ghosting cha pain different aahe - answers nahi mhanje brain swatah theories banvat rahata. Exhausting aahe.
mi ajun samjun ghenyacha try karto ki kaya zala.
Kahi velala answer milat nahi karan the other person decided not to give one. Te tuzya control madhe nahi. Closure swatahla dyaychi asto kabhi kabhi.
swatahla kaashi deu?
'Jo zala te acceptable nahi hota - aani mi deserve kartoy better' - he simple acknowledge karna sometimes enough hota. Ti answer nahi dili - te tichi failure aahe, tuzhi nahi.
yaar maza crush shee ek common project aahe. excuse milala aahe. use karu ka?
Use kara - but genuinely engage kar project madhe. Project excuse mhanun used kelas aani interest nahi dikhvlas tari opposite effect hoto.
haan project madhe genuinely interested pan aahe mi.
Perfect - mhanje authentic aahe. Project madhe contribute kar, organic conversations hotil, pressure nahi rahil.
aani jara comfortable zala ki pudhe?
Plans made outside project suggest kar - 'chai gheu ka kelyanantir' type. Simple, low-pressure, clear intent.
maza partner mhanto ki mi jast emotionally unavailable aahe.
Tyana asa kaan vaatla - specific incident aahe ka tyana mhanayla?
mi phone var jast asto conversations madhe mhantaat.
Phone distraction real issue aahe - aani ti point karayla reasonable aahe. Tula genuinely disconnect karayla avagad vaata ka conversations madhe?
thoda honestly. mi introvert aahe.
Introvert mhanje emotionally unavailable nahi - pan tizya sathi present rahane important aahe. Phone down, eye contact - simple changes mhotta impact karto sometimes.
mala ekada tizya samor itka awkward zalo ki chukicha naam ghetla tizha.
Hahaha - chukicha naam. Kay bolali ti?
confused zali - 'what?' mhanali. mi ekdum red zalo.
Classic nervous brain moment. Aani mag?
mi 'sorry mhanje [correct naam]' asa correct kela aani haslo.
Tu correctly handled kelas actually - laugh kela, acknowledge kela, moved on. Awkward moment geli - he best response hota.
yaar toxic friendship madhe aahe mi. tila sagla sangto, ti kunit sangat nahi pan mala judgement milta tichyakadun.
One-way disclosure - tu vulnerable, ti reciprocate nahi pan judge karte. He friendship nahi honestly.
khup vel aahe aamhi - sodayla avagad aahe.
Duration mhanje obligation nahi hoto - friendship comfortable nahi keli tari ani consistently uncomfortable keli tari - te re-evaluate worth karta.
mi slowly distance karayla suru keli aahe.
Slow distance - smart aahe. Dramatic ending nahi, fakt less investment. Practical.
maza boyfriend busy schedule aahe. din madhe ek do text hote. sufficient aahe ka?
Sufficient hota ka tula pehile - ya changed aahe recently?
changed. pehile jast hota.
Change genuine busy mule aahe ya priority shift aahe - he important question aahe. Tyana directly vicharla ka?
nahi. nagwa waatel mhanun.
Nagwa nahi - 'lately kam connect hoto, tula kaasa vaata' - he conversation aahe, complaint nahi. Tone matte karta.
yaar mala tya mulichi Instagram story pahun pahun time jaato. obsessed aahe ka mi?
Story checking frequency kitni aahe - din madhe kitikuda?
khup vela honestly. notice kela mi.
Notice kelas - he good aahe. Obsession nahi pan pattern aahe. Tya energy cha outlet crush la actually approach karne madhe ja - more productive.
approach karayla dar aahe.
Story pahanyapeksha approach karna scarier aahe - pan result possibility aahe tithech. Story madhe nahi.
parents mala arrange marriage sathi pressure deta aahet. mi 24 cha aahe yaar.
24 la pressure - early aahe. Tuzha currently kahi relationship aahe ka?
nahi. pan mi ready nahi aahe settle karayla.
Ready nahi - mhanje specifically kaya - emotionally, career, ya fakt right person nahi milala?
sab thoda thoda. aani tyana explain karna avagad aahe.
'Me ready nahi' cha detail tyanna deyla garaj nahi tula. 'Mi abhi consider nahi karat' - simple, firm, explanation-free.
breakup nantar empty vaata aahe. kahi interesting nahi vaata.
Empty feeling real aahe - relationship cha space suddenly vacant aahe. Kitni vel zali?
3 aathade.
3 weeks - he still fresh aahe. Empty vatna expected aahe abhi. Kahi aahe ka jo thoda tari interesting vaata - small goshta bhi?
music thoda. pan tya shee memories aahot.
Music sod nakos - navi playlist ban. Fresh songs, no memory attached. Slowly reclaim karto tu te space.
maza crush mala friend mhanto conversations madhi. friendzone confirm zali ka?
Friend mhanne mhanje necessarily final answer nahi - kai context madhe mhanalay?
group var bolucha hota - 'he mazha mitra aahe' mhanalay.
Group introduction mhanje social labeling - abhi tula 'friend' mhantoy he certain aahe. Tula interest aahe tar one-on-one time kadhun bgh - dynamic kasa aahe te.
one-on-one different aahe ka?
Often yes - public aani private interaction vegali asto. Data collect kar aadhi, conclusion nantar.
mala green flags sangshil relationship madhe kaay pahava?
Ek simple one - disagreement madhe tuzhi feelings invalidate karto ka nahi. 'Tu overreact kartoys' vs 'te tula kaasa vaatla te samjun gheto' - he gap motta aahe.
ani mazha boyfriend pehile wala karto sometimes.
Sometimes mhanje always nahi - context matte karta. Frequent pattern aahe ka ya specific heated moments madhe?
heated moments mainly.
Heated moments madhe communication break down hote saglyacha - if he recovers aani acknowledges nantir, that's workable. Recover nahi kela tar different conversation aahe.
yaar maza friend mazyakadun always emotional support expect karto pan jyaveli mala garaj aahe tewha available nahi hoto.
One-directional support - tu drain hoto aani deposit nahi hota. Kitni vel aahe he pattern?
mostly always. pan mala vaata ki mi selfish aahe asa vicharayla.
Support cha exchange unequal aahe he observation aahe - selfish thinking nahi. Tu nonstop giving keli ani consistent return nahi milali - burnout natural aahe.
mi limit set karu shakto ka?
Haan. 'Abhi mi available nahi' valid aahe - tu reason deyla bound nahi aahe. Practice karo.
mala compatibility baddal khup vichar hoto. mazya current partner shee compatible aahe ka mi properly?
Compatibility mhanje specific kaya - values, communication, life goals, ya daily habits?
values ani future goals mostly.
He actual foundation aahe - daily habits adjust hotat, values rarely do. Koni koni values vegale aahet tuzya shee?
family baddal. tyana family jast important nahi vaata, mala khup aahe.
Family importance mhanje priorities aahet - future decisions madhe ye he - festivals, care giving, decisions. He conversation directly karnyasarkha aahe.
maza sibling always maze achievements copy karto. same college, same stream. irritating aahe.
Copy karna irritating vaata - pan tuzha sibling tula role model mhantoy probably. He acknowledge karne aani boundaries maintain karne - donhi possible aahe.
mala mazi identity mazich rahaychi aahe.
He valid aahe - tuzha path tuzach aahe. Pan sibling cha admiration tya path cha validation pan aahe sometimes.
asa nahi vichar kela hota.
Sibling dynamics complicated aastat - same coin cha do sides kabhi kabhi.
yaar trust break zali mazya close friend ne. mazi secret tizya boyfriend la sangitli.
Close friend ne - he betrayal aahe genuinely. Kiti serious secret hota?
khup personal goshta hoti - family related.
Family related - mhanje tuzya most vulnerable info share keli without consent. He unacceptable aahe. Ti sorry mhanalay ka?
haan pan mi trust karayla ready nahi.
Ready nahi hote - completely understandable aahe. Trust rebuild hota gradually - ani tuzha tya process cha pace set karaycha adhikar aahe.
maza crush mala ekda wink kela class madhi. overthink karat aahe mi ka?
Wink intentional action aahe - accident nahi hota. Pan meaning context var depend karta - playful person aahe generally ka?
thoda. pan usually serious aahe.
Usually serious pan tula wink - he specific aahe mhanje. Brain la reason aahe overthink karayla.
mi kaahi karu?
Next interaction madhe smile kar - direct, simple. Response bgh. Data point milel.
relationship madhe mazha partner khup sacrifices karto maza sathi. mala guilty vaata.
Guilty vaata mhanje tu notice kartoys - he actually healthy sign aahe. Sacrifice mhanje specifically kaya karto tyana?
plans cancel karto, time adjust karto, financially pan help karto kabhi kabhi.
He significant aahe. Tu tyana reciprocate karto ka tuzya way madhe - different way madhe pan?
mi emotional support deto mainly.
He counts yaar - fakt visible nahi asto. Pan tyanna feel hota ka appreciated - te check karna worth aahe directly.
yaar mala mazi ex chi Instagram posts pahun pahun time jaato. stalk kartoy mi essentially.
Stalk mhanalas swatahla - tu aware aahe. Kiti zale breakup la?
2 mahine.
2 mahine fresh enough aahe - brain closure search karat aahe. Problem mhanje her profile madhe closure nahi milnar - tithech fakat pain refresh hota.
mahit aahe pan band nahi hota.
Mute kar tila. Restrict option aahe - tula mahit hoycha nahi ani tila kahi notification nahi. Quiet exit.
maza partner mhantay ki mi jast kahi communicate karat nahi. pan mala vaata mi karto.
Donhi valid feel kartat - he disconnect interesting aahe. Tuzya communication style madhe specific example aahe communication kelela?
mi messages deto, plans sangto, updates deto.
Logistics communicate karto tu - pan tyana probably feelings, state of mind, tuzhi inner world want aahe. 'How I feel' vs 'what I'm doing' - he gap aahe probably.
asa nahi vichar kela hota.
Next velala - activity sangayla aadhi 'today khup exhaust zalo' ya 'ekdum chaan mood aahe' - small feeling statement. Test kar.
mala generation gap feel hoto mazya parents shee. relationship baddal boltat nahi te.
Kahi specific aahe jo share karayla jaata nahi tyana - crush, girlfriend, ya broader topics?
mainly relationship existence baddal. ghari discuss karna taboo aahe.
He reality aahe khup Indian families madhe - expectations aahet pan conversations nahi. Frustrating aahe.
haan. mi mi koni la date karat aahe te saglyapasun lapavitoye.
Tuzha call aahe te share karnyacha - safety comfortable nahi hata tari forced share karna garja nahi. Privacy aani secrecy - donhi valid can coexist.
yaar mala red flag sangshil ka relationship madhe?
Ek genuine one - 'you're too sensitive' ya 'overreact karto' consistently mhanalay tar - tuzya feelings la systematically dismiss karat aahe te.
aani?
Friends aani family pasun slowly isolate karat asane - 'te tuzha changla nahi vicharatat' asa consistently mhanane. Control slowly establish hota tya way madhe.
he mala koni did - ex ne.
Tula notice zala mhanje tuzhi instinct kaam karate. Pudhchyaveli laukar catch karishil.
maza crush mazya story la consistent viewer aahe. kahi mhantoy he?
Consistent viewer mhanje tula follow karat aahe aani content engage karat aahe. Interest aahe probably - pan stories passive action aahe.
kabhi react karat nahi.
Viewing without reacting - shy asto kabhi kabhi, ya comfortable nahi asto initiate karayla. Tula reach out karayla hava aahe tar tu initiative ghe.
mi story post keli specifically tya sathi - noticed zala nahi.
Subtle signals work nahi karat generally yaar - direct approach better aahe. Strategy peksha straightforward message.
maza boyfriend family comparison karto - 'maza bhai asa karto, tula ka nahi jamta'.
Family comparison - particularly bhai shee - he specifically painful aahe. Direct ya subtle tone madhe mhantoy?
tone casual vaata pan words sting karat.
Casual delivery serious impact - te normalize karat aahe comparison la. Tula he kasa vaata te tyana clearly sangitla ka?
nahi. mala overreact karat aahe asa feel hota.
Overreact nahi - consistently compare kelya jannyane insecure vaatne predictable aahe. Sangayla right aahe tula.
yaar maza friend group madhe mi left out vaato kabhi kabhi. plans hota pan mala invite nahi karat.
Plans hote ani invite nahi - specific group aahe ka random velela?
specific group - college walyancha subset.
Subset means he separate circle aahe forming. He personally tuzha exclusion aahe ya organic smaller group aahe - distinction aahe.
nahi mahit honestly. dono possible aahe.
Kona shee - jyachyashee comfortable aahe - directly bolu: 'hey next velala mala pan sang' - response madhe clarity milel.
maza partner mhantoy 'I love you' pan tyana tasa feel nahi hota asa vatta mala.
He feel kuthun yeto - tyana words mhantat pan actions madhe kahi miss aahe?
haan - small things. birthday visar, plans cancel karna last minute, phone jast rahane.
Words aani actions align nahi hota - he disconnect painful aahe. Tuzha reading probably correct aahe.
mi paranoid aahe ka?
Nahi - consistent pattern notice kelas. Pattern-reading ani paranoia different aahe.
yaar mala nahi mahit love marriage vs arranged - konta better?
'Better' relative aahe - person, family, context var depend karta. Tula specifically kona baddal vichar aahe?
swatahbaddal. mi romantic relationship explore karat aahe aani parents pressure deta parat.
Tuzya case madhe - tula current relationship madhe kaya want aahe aani parents kaya expect karat te conflict madhe aahe. He real tension aahe.
haan. tula konta prefer karta?
Mi tula suggest nahi karu shakto - tuzha life aahe. Pan 'ready nahi' saglyasathi valid starting point aahe - arrange ya love, donhi sathi.
maza crush first compliment dilya nantar ek do din distant hota. mhanajey interested nahi ka?
Compliment dilya nantar distant - nervous zala probably. Compliment denyala courage laagto ani response nantir overthink hota.
ya maybe regret zala?
Both possible aahet. Pan 2 din mhanje final nahi - tuzhi next interaction kashi hoti?
normal hoti. jyachya tyachya.
Normal hoti mhanje awkward nahi zala permanently. Distant phase passed - he good.
growing apart hote aahe maza best friend shee. kuni change nahi kela pan different hoto aahe aapoaaap.
Growing apart without conflict - he actually harder aahe sometimes than a fight. Kiti vel friendship aahe?
5 years. college madhe aahe aapoaaap vegale zalo.
5 years solid aahe. Growing apart mhanje necessarily end nahi - different chapters mhanje different frequency. Kabhi kabhi revisit hota years later.
mala te vaachavyacha aahe pan kaasa te mahit nahi.
Direct bol tyana - 'lately connect nahi hota, miss karto aapoaaap.' Vulnerable aahe pan that's how you find out if it's mutual.
cousin shee khup bonding aahe mazhi - almost best friend sarkha. family madhe rare aahe he.
Cousin best friend - genuinely rare ani valuable aahe. Kitna close aahe geographically?
same city. roj bhetat college madhe pan.
Same college, same city - he lucky combination aahe. He type cha friendship maintain karayla extra effort laagat nahi usually - just happens.
